title: 食安风波冲击餐饮业，消费者信心待修复
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: A double whammy of food-borne illness is putting consumer trust to the test.
segments.zh: 食源性疾病双重打击考验消费者信任。

segments.en: An outbreak of the parasitic pathogen, Cyclospora, tied to raw lettuce, plus a salmonella flera tied to jalapenos.
segments.zh: 与生菜相关的环孢子虫寄生虫爆发，加上与墨西哥辣椒相关的沙门氏菌。

segments.en: It's putting restaurants and food brands under pressure.
segments.zh: 这给餐馆和食品品牌带来压力。

segments.en: Cyclospora has had an impact on our business as it has had a business, had an impact on really anyone selling fresh produce.
segments.zh: 环孢子虫对我们的业务造成了影响，就像对任何销售新鲜农产品的人一样。

segments.en: We want to be prudent with our guidance and take into account what we noted to be the impact of some of the broader concerns around food safety issues.
segments.zh: 我们希望谨慎对待指引，并考虑到我们注意到的食品安全问题的一些更广泛担忧的影响。

segments.en: Usually for our eating a little bit less greens as they sort of process the information that's been happening.
segments.zh: 通常，当消费者消化这些信息时，他们会少吃一点绿叶蔬菜。

segments.en: But it wasn't too long ago that some CEOs didn't sound so concerned.
segments.zh: 但不久前，一些CEO听起来并不那么担忧。

segments.en: We're not affected at all and I think customers understand that the supply chain moves very quickly. The product is probably out of the supply chain and everything's fine.
segments.zh: 我们完全不受影响，我认为客户理解供应链运转非常快。产品可能已经离开供应链，一切正常。

segments.en: We have gone through our supply chain ingredients with our partners to understand if any of our ingredients have been indicated in the cyclospora outbreak
segments.zh: 我们已与合作伙伴检查了供应链中的成分，以了解是否有任何成分与环孢子虫爆发有关。

segments.en: and they haven't today. We don't expect that they will.
segments.zh: 目前没有，我们预计也不会有。

segments.en: But now food safety concerns, they're just too big to ignore.
segments.zh: 但现在食品安全问题，已经大到无法忽视。

segments.en: Placer.ai, a foot traffic analytics firm, says visits are down at some major fast food chains, including Taco Bell, where the CDC traced part of the cyclospora outbreak.
segments.zh: Placer.ai是一家客流量分析公司，数据显示一些主要快餐连锁店的客流量下降，包括塔可钟，CDC将部分环孢子虫疫情追溯到该店。

segments.en: It's all about communication. When consumers don't have confidence in what happened to cause the outbreak, what solutions were put in place to make it happen. That makes it very difficult.
segments.zh: 关键在于沟通。当消费者对疫情原因及应对措施缺乏信心时，问题就变得棘手。
